system.description: Hand a debt you owe from Fey's Debt to another willing character. You cannot use the skill again until that debt has been fulfilled. No cost, no action type, at will — and explicitly your own Fey's Debt debts only; an NPC's debt or an obligation incurred any other way does not qualify. The self-lock is the balance: one outstanding transfer at a time, and it stays locked until somebody else clears your obligation.
